description: Source code implementing environment variable management functions for the lighttpd server, including initialization, setting, retrieval, duplication, and CGI-specific transformations.

classes.name: liEnvironment
classes.description: Structure representing the environment variables hash table.

classes.name: liEnvironmentDup
classes.description: Structure representing a duplicated environment variables hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_init(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Initializes a liEnvironment structure by creating a new hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_reset(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Removes all entries from the environment hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_clear(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Destroys the environment hash table and resets the pointer.

methods.name: void li_environment_set(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the environment hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_insert(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the environment hash table, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: void li_environment_remove(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Removes an entry based on the key from the environment hash table.

methods.name: GString * li_environment_get(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the environment hash table.

methods.name: liEnvironmentDup * li_environment_make_dup(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the current environment hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_dup_free(liEnvironmentDup * envdup)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a duplicate environment structure.

methods.name: GString * li_environment_dup_pop(liEnvironmentDup * envdup,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a value from the duplicate environment based on a key.

methods.name: void add_env_var(liEnvironmentDup * envdup,liAddEnvironmentCB callback,gpointer param,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Adds an environment variable, either by popping from a duplicate or using a callback.

methods.name: void cgi_fix_header_name(GString * str)
methods.description: Transforms HTTP header names to CGI environment variable format.

methods.name: void li_environment_dup2cgi(liVRequest * vr,liEnvironmentDup * envdup,liAddEnvironmentCB callback,gpointer param)
methods.description: Converts environment variables for CGI exposure from a request context.

ctags.signature: (liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
